# NetworkCore

> NetworkCore connects charge point operators (CPOs) with distribution partners (DPs): mobility apps, fleets and car makers. CPOs connect once over OCPI 2.2.1. Partners integrate one REST API.

## How to connect

- **CPO**: NetworkCore is the eMSP. Base URL `https://ocpi.networkcore.org`. A three-token credentials handshake (Token A from the CPO, Token B from NetworkCore, Token C from the CPO), then standard OCPI modules: credentials, locations, tariffs, tokens, commands, sessions, cdrs. Header: `Authorization: Token <base64>`.
- **DP**: JSON over HTTPS. Base URL `https://dp.networkcore.org`. Header: `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`. Two levels: Data (locations, availability, tariffs, quotes) and Full charging (start and stop sessions, webhooks, receipts and tax invoices, disputes). Sessions run PENDING, ACTIVE, COMPLETED or FAILED. Requests are idempotent by `order_id`. Webhooks are signed per Standard Webhooks.

## Docs

- [CPO onboarding](https://developers.networkcore.org/cpo/onboarding.html): handshake, tokens, charging flow, requirements.
- [DP API reference](https://developers.networkcore.org/dp-api/reference.html): endpoints, conventions, webhooks, errors.
- [Sandbox](https://developers.networkcore.org/sandbox.html): test stations and go-live checklists for partners and CPOs.
